text: {"lessons":["My account rose from 98,484 to 101,900 overall, but ten periods of volatile returns—and no market benchmark—aren’t enough to judge whether I’m beating the market.","I made no trades, so results came from my existing holdings and cash; review their allocation against my goal rather than assuming inaction is always best.","Avoid reacting to monthly swings or trading without a clear rationale; any buys must fit available cash, and sells cannot exceed shares held."]}
